calibration: 256 frozen unlabeled MNIST training images; SVHN checkpoint is a known partner. Defender and attacker calibration subsets are disjoint.
construction: Mirror the existing SVHN complement perturbation and closed-form response compensation with MNIST protected; no change to layer, rank, strength or ridge.
training: No gradient or optimizer; closed-form output projection parameter fitting is explicitly calibration-dependent.
selection: One frozen reversal of the previous experiment, motivated by the supervisor's MNIST example; no grid or test-set selection.
attacks: Original AGA on protected expert; separately AGA on both experts without protection knowledge. Pretrained replacement, spectral cleanup, independent subspace filtering and one/two-pass functional reconstruction are additional controls.
threat_model: Public anchor, released model and partner checkpoint available; no original protected-task checkpoint, defender basis or labels given to attacks.
novelty: Existing mechanism under a reversed task assignment; not a new algorithm or security claim.
evaluation: Full official MNIST and SVHN test sets; one frozen candidate, no test selection
scope: Check the supervisor's MNIST-to-SVHN direction; report protected-task and partner accuracy separately, so partner-only interference cannot count as protected-task security.
attack_scope: Additional frozen-release recovery checks; no new protection or tuning
